title: Project setup: monorepo, TypeScript, lint, tests, CI, staging deploy, error tracking
acceptance: A push runs CI; staging deploys automatically; a thrown test error appears in the error tracker.
note: monorepo, TypeScript, lint, tests and CI done; staging deploy and error tracking not set up

title: Database foundation: migrations, organisation key on every table, Row-Level Security helpers, isolation test harness
acceptance: An automated test proves organisation A cannot read or write organisation B rows on every table; CI fails if a new table has no policy.
note: migrations, organisation_id everywhere, app.* RLS helpers, pgTAP coverage guard in CI

title: Signup and verification: create agency or individual-landlord organisation with owner, email/phone verification, password reset
acceptance: A new user can sign up, verify, reset a password and land in an empty organisation as Owner.
note: signup, email confirmation, password reset, sign-in/out, session refresh middleware and organisation setup; phone verification and staff invitations are ORG-2 clauses with no ticket

title: Roles, permissions and scoped access (property and portfolio level)
acceptance: A Caretaker assigned to one property cannot open another property's records, tested at API level.
note: memberships, assignments, app.has_role, permission catalogue; AC is API-level and met

title: Audit log service: append-only events with who, when, before and after
acceptance: Editing a record writes an audit event; audit rows cannot be edited or deleted through the API.
note: audit_events append-only with before/after and reason

title: Session management: device list, remote sign-out, timeout
acceptance: A user can end another device's session and it is rejected on its next request.
note: device_sessions table and own-device policies; device list and remote sign-out API not built

title: Design system and web shell using the Tenaville palette
acceptance: Shared layout, navigation, form and table components render on desktop and mobile widths.
note: UI kit integrated with a drift and contrast test; shell with role-filtered navigation, theme toggle, layout, form and table components; verified rendering at desktop and 375px with no page overflow

title: Landlord records with remittance details
acceptance: A landlord can be created with contact details, preferred channel and bank details visible only to authorised roles.
note: landlords plus landlord_remittance_details, restricted policy, masked audit

title: Properties: create, edit, photos, notes, no public exposure
acceptance: A property saves with photos; no unauthenticated URL or search index exposes it.
note: properties, property_photos, no public grant; create/edit screens not built

title: Units and statuses
acceptance: Units can be added under a property with vacant, occupied, reserved, under maintenance and inactive statuses.
note: units with the five PROP-3 statuses; occupancy follows the lease

title: Link property to landlord
acceptance: A property cannot be saved without one landlord; reassigning is audited.
note: properties.landlord_id with a same-organisation trigger

title: Management mandate: commission type and rate, remittance schedule, permitted deductions
acceptance: A mandate saves per landlord or property and is versioned so past statements keep their original terms.
note: management_mandates with commission, schedule and deduction constraints

title: Import framework with templates, validation and row-level errors; apply to properties and units
acceptance: Uploading a file with 3 bad rows creates nothing until fixed and returns an error list naming each row and field.
note: header mapping, row-level validation, dry run, apply_property_import

title: Private file storage: signed URLs, image compression, authorisation at download
acceptance: A file link expires, cannot be guessed, and fails for a user without access to the record.
note: private buckets, signed URLs, image compression and download authorisation not built; property photos and deduction evidence already store paths nothing can serve

title: Tenant records and contacts
acceptance: A tenant stores contacts and optional next-of-kin and employer details with change history.
note: tenants and tenant_contacts

title: Create lease directly: parties, unit, dates, rent, frequency, deposit and other upfront charges
acceptance: A lease can be created from a tenant and unit without an application; the unit becomes occupied on activation.
note: create_lease_with_tenant with parties and deposit in one transaction

title: Lease states and history preservation
acceptance: State changes follow allowed transitions; editing a tenant never alters historical lease terms.
note: stored lifecycle plus derived expiring_soon; history preserved on renewal

title: Charge and rent schedule generation (annual, half-yearly, quarterly, monthly, irregular)
acceptance: Activating a lease produces the correct dated charges, including a one-off irregular schedule, with totals matching lease terms.
note: generateRentPeriods computes the schedule; Charge rows are not persisted yet

title: Renewals that retain history
acceptance: A renewal creates a linked new lease and keeps the previous terms viewable.
note: renew_lease links the new lease, carries parties and transfers the deposit

title: Expiry alert engine (90, 60, 30 days, configurable)
acceptance: Leases entering each configured window create a task for the responsible agent once only.
note: derived state and alert threshold in lease_overview; the sending engine needs comms (Sprint 7)

title: Move-in and move-out records: handover notes, meter readings, balance
acceptance: Move-out records outstanding balance and prompts deposit handling before closing the lease.
note: lease_handovers with meter readings, balance, keys and evidence

title: Record payments with method, reference, proof upload; label recorded vs partner-confirmed
acceptance: A payment saves with its method and proof and displays 'recorded by staff', never 'confirmed'.

title: Allocation engine: oldest-first, manual override, part payment, overpayment, tenant credit
acceptance: The sum of allocations always equals the payment; overpayment becomes credit; override requires permission and is audited.

title: Receipts: sequential numbering per organisation or branch, PDF, shareable link
acceptance: Two concurrent payments never receive the same number; a voided receipt keeps its number and is never reused.

title: Reversals and corrections without overwriting history
acceptance: Reversing a payment creates a linked reversing entry with a reason; the original stays visible.

title: Daily cash-up per user and payment method
acceptance: A user's cash-up lists all payments recorded that day grouped by method and totals match the ledger.

title: Landlord ledger core: append-only entries, client funds separated from agency funds
acceptance: Every receipt creates ledger entries on the correct side; a test proves client and agency balances never mix.

title: Commission calculation per mandate, recognised on cash received by default
acceptance: Commission matches the mandate on partial and full payments; reversing a payment reverses its commission.

title: Caution deposit lifecycle as client funds
acceptance: A deposit is held, deducted with evidence or refunded, each step producing a ledger entry.
note: lifecycle, deductions and custody built in Sprint 3; the ledger entry per step needs the landlord ledger

title: Remittance recording with balance guard
acceptance: A remittance above the available balance is blocked unless an authorised role approves an advance, which is recorded as a debit.

title: Rent roll, upcoming dues and arrears ageing views
acceptance: Arrears buckets (1-30, 31-60, 61-90, 90+) reconcile to the sum of overdue charges.

title: Statements: draft, reviewed, issued; immutable; numbered revisions; PDF; access limited to staff and that landlord
acceptance: An issued statement cannot be edited; a correction produces Revision 2 linked to the original; another landlord cannot open it.

title: Evidence attachments on ledger entries
acceptance: Receipts, invoices and approvals attach to the entry they support and show on the statement.

title: Import tenants, leases and current charges
acceptance: A valid file creates linked tenants, leases and charges; errors are reported per row.

title: Opening balances at a cutover date: tenant arrears and credits, landlord balances
acceptance: Opening entries are labelled and locked after cutover confirmation; totals equal the agency's supplied figures.

title: Dry-run and rollback for import batches
acceptance: A dry-run shows what would be created; rolling back a completed batch removes only that batch.

title: Full organisation data export
acceptance: An administrator can export all organisation data in documented formats at any time, including after a subscription lapses.

title: Messaging provider abstraction and message log (WhatsApp, SMS, email)
acceptance: Switching provider is configuration only; each message stores recipient, template, time, status and related record.

title: Configurable templates with merge fields
acceptance: Reminder, receipt, expiry and maintenance templates render the correct tenant, unit and amount values.

title: Consent, opt-outs, channel preferences and rate limits
acceptance: An opted-out contact receives no marketing message; operational messages follow channel preference.

title: WhatsApp template approval tracking and fallback channel
acceptance: A business-initiated message uses only an approved template; a failed WhatsApp send retries by SMS or email.

title: Tasks with owner, due date, priority, related record
acceptance: A task links to a lease, tenant or request and shows in the owner's daily list.

title: Reminder and follow-up rules for upcoming and overdue charges and expiries
acceptance: Configured reminders send once per rule, stop when paid, and log each send.

title: Create maintenance requests with category, urgency, access notes, media
acceptance: Staff or a tenant can raise a request with photos against a property or unit.

title: Core statuses and transitions
acceptance: Only allowed transitions are accepted; each is timestamped.

title: Assignment, priority, due date, responsible staff
acceptance: An unassigned request appears in the manager's queue; assignment notifies the assignee.

title: Timeline, comments and attachments
acceptance: All changes and messages appear in order on the request.

title: Vendor directory
acceptance: A vendor can be created with trade, areas and notes and selected for a job.

title: Actual cost, invoices, receipts, before/after photos, completion notes
acceptance: A job cannot be completed without a recorded cost or an explicit 'no cost' flag.

title: Allocate repair cost to landlord, tenant, agency or other payer with ledger link
acceptance: A landlord-borne cost appears as a deduction on the next statement; a tenant-borne cost creates a tenant charge.

title: Repair history persists against the unit after a tenancy ends
acceptance: A new tenant's unit view still shows earlier repairs.

title: Document management: attach to records, types, issue and expiry dates, audit
acceptance: A document attached to a lease shows uploader, type and dates and is hidden from unauthorised users.

title: Landlord portal (read-only): properties, occupancy, collections, balances, statements
acceptance: A landlord sees only their own properties and issued statements; no edit actions are available.
note: read-only policies enforced and tested; portal screens and statements not built

title: Tenant access linked to organisation, tenant and active lease; responsive mobile web
acceptance: A tenant signs in or uses a secure link and sees only their own lease data on a phone browser.

title: Tenant view: lease summary, dues, recorded payments, receipts, shared documents
acceptance: Balances shown match the ledger; only documents explicitly shared appear.

title: Tenant repair request and status notifications
acceptance: A tenant submits a request with photos and receives acknowledgement and completion notices.

title: Mobile foundation: Expo app, login, navigation, PIN or biometric lock
acceptance: The app signs in, locks after inactivity and unlocks with PIN or biometrics.

title: Mobile: tenants, arrears, record payment and send receipt
acceptance: A payment recorded on the phone appears on the web app with a receipt sent to the tenant.

title: Mobile: maintenance logging with photos, tasks and follow-ups
acceptance: A repair logged on the phone shows photos and assignment on the web app.

title: Low-data operation: image compression, resumable uploads, pagination
acceptance: A 5 MB photo uploads under 500 KB and an interrupted upload resumes.

title: Push notifications for tasks, assignments and alerts
acceptance: An assigned task triggers a push notification that opens the task.

title: Local store and outbox with client-generated IDs
acceptance: Records created offline persist across app restarts and queue for sync.

title: Idempotent sync endpoints and conflict rules (server-authoritative for money)
acceptance: Replaying the same batch five times creates each payment once; last-writer-wins is never applied to financial records.

title: Provisional receipts and server-assigned official numbers on sync
acceptance: An offline receipt is marked 'pending sync' and receives its official number only on sync, with the tenant notified.

title: Sync status per record, visible retry, no silent discard
acceptance: Failed items show a reason and a retry; none disappear.

title: Encrypted local storage, remote revoke and local wipe
acceptance: Revoking a device from the web wipes cached data on its next connection.

title: Subscription plans by units, trial, naira billing through a payment gateway, invoices
acceptance: A trial converts to a paid plan with an invoice and receipt; plan limits follow units under management.

title: Plan limits, upgrade prompts, grace period, no deletion for non-payment
acceptance: Exceeding a limit shows a prompt and a grace period; data and export remain available after lapse.

title: Core operational reports with CSV and PDF export
acceptance: Rent roll, occupancy, expiries, arrears, collections and repairs reports reconcile to ledger totals.

title: Enforce access rules in reports, exports and dashboards
acceptance: A scoped manager's exports contain only their permitted properties.

title: Security hardening: dependency scanning, rate limiting, backup and restore drill
acceptance: A restore from backup to a clean environment succeeds and is timed; critical dependency alerts are zero.

title: Performance and load testing, monitoring and alerts
acceptance: Core screens meet the load target in the PRD on a mid-range phone connection.

title: Pilot onboarding runbook, sample templates and support routine
acceptance: A new pilot agency can be loaded using the runbook without developer help beyond import support.

title: Onboard three pilot agencies and import their data
acceptance: Opening balances reconcile to each agency's own records at cutover.

title: Run pilot month-end: statements, remittances, feedback triage
acceptance: Statements are accepted by pilot agencies and landlords without manual correction; feedback is triaged into the backlog.

title: App store and Play Store release preparation
acceptance: Internal test builds distribute to pilot staff; store listings and privacy information are ready.

title: R1 exit-criteria verification and defect buffer
acceptance: Every exit criterion in PRD section 16.2 is checked and recorded; no critical isolation or security defects remain open.

title: Payment partner selection, integration boundary and sandbox
acceptance: A decision record names the partner and settlement flow; a provider-neutral interface passes sandbox tests.

title: Virtual accounts per unit or tenant
acceptance: Each active lease can receive a virtual account number that maps unambiguously to that lease.

title: Signed, idempotent, replay-protected webhooks
acceptance: A duplicate or replayed webhook creates no second payment; an invalid signature is rejected and logged.

title: Settlement-account model in ledger and statements
acceptance: Settlement into agency client account, landlord account or split is configurable and reflected in the ledger.

title: Payment links per charge
acceptance: A tenant can pay a charge through a link and the payment is allocated automatically.

title: Auto-matching and review queue for unmatched payments
acceptance: A payment with a known reference matches automatically; the rest appear in a queue with suggested matches.

title: Tenant view of partner-confirmed payments and payment instructions
acceptance: Tenants see confirmed versus recorded payments clearly labelled, plus their account details.

title: Scheduled remittance runs with approval and reconciliation
acceptance: A run lists landlords due, requires approval, and each remittance reconciles to a bank reference.

title: Branded PDF statements
acceptance: A statement can use agency branding and downloads as PDF.

title: Exports for external accounting tools
acceptance: An export file imports cleanly into a reference accounting tool with a documented mapping.

title: Late fee rules where policy and law permit
acceptance: Late fees apply only when enabled, follow the configured rule and are visible to the tenant.

title: Lead capture (manual and agency channels) with contact data
acceptance: A lead can be created from a call, WhatsApp or private enquiry form with consent notice.

title: Pipeline stages, assignment, source and next action
acceptance: Each lead has an owner, stage, source and a next action with a due date.

title: Chronological activity timeline
acceptance: Calls, messages, tasks and notes appear in order on the lead.

title: Follow-up reminders and daily queue
acceptance: An agent sees today's and overdue follow-ups; overdue items alert the manager.

title: Duplicate detection and merge preserving history
acceptance: Likely duplicates are flagged; merging keeps all activity.

title: Lost reasons, nurture dates, reactivation
acceptance: A lost lead can be reactivated without creating a new record.

title: CRM messaging templates and marketing consent
acceptance: Marketing messages are blocked without consent; tenancy messages stay separate.

title: Appointments: types, links, scheduling, conflict flagging, reschedule
acceptance: Double-booking a staff member is flagged; an appointment links to a lead, tenant or property.

title: Confirmations and reminders with delivery status
acceptance: Attendees receive configured reminders and the delivery status is stored.

title: Outcomes, automatic follow-up tasks and viewing feedback
acceptance: Recording 'interested' creates a follow-up task with owner and due date.

title: Calendar and list views with filters
acceptance: Staff can filter the agenda by team, type and status.

title: Shareable unit sheets (private, expiring, non-indexed)
acceptance: A unit sheet link expires, is excluded from search engines and shows only chosen fields.

title: Vacancy history
acceptance: Each vacancy records dates, reason and next action; reports show vacancy duration.

title: Lead to application to lease conversion without re-entry
acceptance: Converting an approved lead creates the tenant and lease with prefilled data.

title: Screening templates and configurable steps with evidence types and deadlines
acceptance: A template with required and optional steps can be applied to a property and overridden by a landlord.

title: Applicant form and secure document upload
acceptance: An applicant completes the form and uploads evidence through the portal.

title: Status workflow, reviewer assignment, request for more information
acceptance: Reviewers move an application through statuses and the applicant is notified of required actions.

title: Consent capture with purpose, timestamp and privacy notice version
acceptance: No application data is processed without a recorded consent for each purpose.

title: Review audit trail and restricted access
acceptance: Only authorised roles see screening data; every review action is logged.

title: Sensitive identifier handling: masking and verification results only
acceptance: National or financial identifiers are masked by default and not stored where a pass or fail result suffices.

title: Block lease activation while required steps are incomplete, with authorised override
acceptance: An incomplete application cannot activate a lease without a recorded override and reason.

title: Retention and anonymisation for rejected or withdrawn applications
acceptance: Data is anonymised or deleted after the configured period and the action is logged.

title: Fairness controls: prohibited criteria guard and criteria versioning
acceptance: Templates cannot use prohibited characteristics; each decision records the criteria version.

title: Screening reports
acceptance: Reports show volumes and completion times without exposing unnecessary personal data.

title: Co-tenants and guarantors
acceptance: A lease can have several tenants and guarantors, each with their own contacts.

title: Rent review and escalation rules with approval
acceptance: A configured increase proposes new terms that need approval before applying.

title: Notices and letters from agency templates
acceptance: A formal reminder or expiry notice generates from a template and is stored on the lease.

title: Configurable tax lines (VAT on commission, withholding on rent), off by default
acceptance: Enabling a tax line changes statements and reports as configured and is audited; default behaviour is unchanged.

title: Vendor quotations and comparison
acceptance: Two or more quotes can be attached to a request and compared side by side.

title: Approval thresholds and landlord approvals with comments in the portal
acceptance: A job above the threshold cannot proceed until the landlord approves, and the history is kept.

title: Work orders
acceptance: A work order records scope, vendor, target date and agreed cost.

title: Tenant confirm or reopen, and repair tracking for tenants
acceptance: A tenant can confirm resolution or reopen with a reason; they see status and next step.

title: Preventive maintenance schedules
acceptance: A recurring schedule generates requests on time.

title: Emergency escalation rules and action log
acceptance: An emergency request notifies named contacts and records every action taken.

title: Inspection checklists on mobile with photos, notes, meter readings, acknowledgement
acceptance: An inspection completed offline syncs with photos and a signature or acknowledgement.

title: Document expiry alerts, malware scanning and time-limited links
acceptance: An expiring document alerts staff; an infected test file is rejected.

title: Custom fields and property documents
acceptance: Admins can add fields per property or unit and attach operating documents.

title: Tenant portal extras: contact updates, secure request channel, renewal prompts, accessibility
acceptance: A tenant can state renewal intent without auto-renewing; screens meet the accessibility and low-data targets.

title: Landlord portfolio indicators
acceptance: A landlord sees agreed indicators for occupancy, arrears and costs.

title: Branches, teams and branch-level reporting
acceptance: Reports and access can be limited to a branch.

title: Analytics foundation: filters, documented metric definitions, configurable occupancy denominator
acceptance: Every metric shows its formula and time window; occupancy excludes configured unit statuses.

title: Collections and landlord dashboards
acceptance: Billed versus collected, arrears ageing and landlord net remittance reconcile to the ledger.

title: Lease, vacancy and maintenance dashboards
acceptance: Expiry pipeline, vacancy duration, response and resolution times and repeat issues are shown.

title: CRM funnel analytics
acceptance: Response time, appointment attendance and conversion are reported.

title: Export reports to CSV, XLSX and PDF
acceptance: Exports respect scope and match on-screen totals.

title: Organisation settings: approval limits, workflow templates, notification preferences
acceptance: Admins can change limits and templates without code changes; changes are audited.

title: Optional two-factor authentication
acceptance: Users can enable 2FA and admins can require it for specific roles.

title: Recurring tasks and event-driven task creation
acceptance: A configured event creates tasks automatically without duplicates.

title: Inbox for messages needing a human reply
acceptance: Inbound replies appear in a work queue linked to the contact, within provider limits.

title: Onboarding checklist and assisted import tooling
acceptance: A new organisation sees a checklist and can use sample templates for each import.

title: Supported OS versions and forced-update policy
acceptance: An outdated app version with a breaking API change is prompted to update.

title: Validate optional transaction-fee model before building
acceptance: A written decision confirms legal, pricing and tenant-impact review before any fee is implemented.

title: R2 security review, performance test and regression pack
acceptance: No critical findings open; regression suite covers R1 and R2 money, ledger and isolation paths.

title: R2 pilot rollout and exit-criteria verification
acceptance: Pilot agencies run payments, CRM and maintenance in production and R2 exit criteria are recorded as met.
